text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One effective way to do this is by using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. This method helps teams stay focused and track their progress. Throughout a project, it is also important to set milestones, which are key points in time that mark important progress. Another key element is defining deliverables, the tangible results or products that the team must complete. Finally, before the project begins, it is crucial to ensure stakeholder alignment. This means everyone involved agrees on the goals and expectations, which prevents misunderstandings later.
